lead_raw_text:
The structure of AlCo₃Pd crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—2 Al, 6 Co, and 2 Pd—distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, Co centers with 10 or 9 neighbors, and Pd centers with 8 neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like arrangement. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al and Pd polyhedra, corner- and face-sharing between Al and Co polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Co polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
